caveats: The host must be a Mac on macOS 14 or later with the Xcode command line tools; any Paseo client can view it.
Someone at the host must grant Paseo Screen Recording and Accessibility once, then reopen Paseo.
Frames are polled JPEGs at roughly 5 to 15 fps depending on the network, so it is not smooth video.
Anyone paired with the host can see and control its screen while the plugin is enabled.
Clipboard sync is text only and works on desktop and web clients.
